decision.observation: Standing on dry sand now; green stamina refilling (~35%) with a dark teal segment and the hatched yellow tail. Palms and banana trees rise inland at right, with boulders, dry grass and driftwood on the upper bank ahead.
decision.hypothesis: On solid ground the meter can recover fully. Head inland up the sand bank toward the palms and boulder line to continue the route.
decision.memory: Beach landing confirmed; inland bank has palms, banana trees, boulders, driftwood.
